title: 取消单独的提醒
prompt: Use case: precise story illustration edit. Recompose the image as a FIRST PERSON POV close-up. Show ONLY the holder's two hands with washed blue denim jacket cuffs and a single black smartphone front, no face or head or torso portrait. The owner and viewer share the same viewpoint looking down at the front display. Palm behind phone, fingers curl at edges, no fingers laid across text, no rear camera array on the display side. Reference 2 gives the correct hands-and-phone perspective only; its cafe, cup, time and reminder content must not be copied. The screen and hands occupy the upper central two-thirds. Only the phone interface changes: contact heading exactly “孟遥”, rows “置顶” and “提醒”, both switches OFF in grey with the knob at the left; a small “聊天记录” entry remains. No deletion, blocking or meeting invitation. No dates or other invented text. Background is a neutral blurred tabletop with no recognizable location. 保持完整横向16:9画幅、细腻半写实画风，不增加文字、边框、标题或水印。

shot.title: 取消单独的提醒

source.quote: 挂断前，她叫了最后一声文文。我答应，随后说再见。她也说了。我等手心不再都是汗，才取消置顶，关掉单独的提醒。
